name: ROGUE
quote: You live and operate in the margins, striking unseen and disappearing before anyone knows you were there.

coreTalent.name: EXPERTISE
coreTalent.description: Choose three skills below as your skill set. Take +1d when using a chosen skill. Each session, you have a 4d Competence pool to represent your focus under pressure. You can roll it as bonus dice after any of the chosen skills. Above board: duel - evade - investigate - persuade - track - traverse. Below table: ambush - forgery & disguise - lying - sabotage - sleight of hand - stealth. [Growth: At levels 3 and 6, gain +1d Competence per session and +1 skill.]

details.name: THIEVES GUILD [OPTIONAL]
details.description:
Many rogues learned their trade from a thieves' guild, criminal ring, or underground network. These are all one form of a guild or another, whether formal or not.

THIEVES GUILD: Choose 2 that describe your guild and 1 that really doesn't.

○ Like family○ Turf-obsessed○ Mystics○ Scoundrels
○ Elite training○ Heroes○ Outsiders○ In the open
○ Cultish○ Mercenaries○ Renegades○ Wardens

details.name: CRIMINAL HISTORY [OPTIONAL]
details.description:
Given their skillset, a rogue either learned their trade by way of crime or possess the skills to make an excellent criminal, for which there's no lack of opportunities. As you start your adventuring career, it's likely you have some lingering criminal history, a past that can come back to haunt you in quite fun, dramatic ways.

Create one or more past crimes by setting the crime (severity & nature), your reputation from it, and your own reaction about the crime.

THE CRIMEREPUTATION

low-levelsmuggling, banditry, kidnappingsmall bounty

REACTION: I did what I had to do—I was set up—It was a misunderstanding—I'd do it again in a heartbeat—I completely forgot I did that—I've made peace with it—Never again. Or write one!

pathTalent.name: ACCORDING TO PLAN
pathTalent.description: You gain 1 thread per session and can spend thread to flashback, establishing how you planned for the current situation. Make a montage roll, taking +1d if it fell within your expertise. The GM must take suspense in place of an impact move.

pathTalent.name: DISTRACTION
pathTalent.description: On a perfect, you can setup an ally and pass them the spotlight, even if the GM wants to spend suspense.

pathTalent.name: ELDRITCH AFFINITY
pathTalent.description: You have spellcasting, as the Sorcery talent. You roll Presence to cast and choose 3 from magic paths and techniques. You can't cast potent spells, nor do you risk a magical twist. [Prohibited: Sorcerer] Magic Paths & Techniques

pathTalent.name: LURKER
pathTalent.description: On a perfect sneaking past or secretly observing sentient creatures, they: let a secret slip - give you a golden opportunity. If caught sneaking, you can push yourself to stay completely still and avoid detection, but must leave the area immediately after.

pathTalent.name: OPPORTUNIST
pathTalent.description: When someone nearby rolls defense, you take +1d on an immediate follow-up. On a critical by a nearby ally, you can push yourself to add a critical bonus.

pathTalent.name: POISONER
pathTalent.description: Each session, you have a 4d Poisons resource pool. You have access to the following poisons: hallucinations - knockout - memory loss - nausea - paralytic - truth serum. They each take a bit of time to work and are most effective if ingested.

pathTalent.name: WEASEL
pathTalent.description: Once per session, if caught in a lie or red-handed, you can weasel your way out - for now. Make a story roll to see if they realize their mistake later. You can push yourself to do it again.
